div.head: V Atr 21
div.ab: ⁊ si ælc wydewe, þe hy sylfe mid rihte gehealde, on Godes griðe ⁊ on þæs cynges.
⁊ sy ælc wydewe, þe hy sylfe mid rihte gehealde, on Godes griðe ⁊ on þæs cynges.
⁊ si ælc wuduwe þe hi silfe mid rihte healde on Godes griðe ⁊ on ðæs cynges.
And sy ælc wydewe, þe hy sylfe mid rihte gehealde, on Godes griðe and on þæs cynges.
And all widows who lead a respectable life shall enjoy the special protection of God and of the king.
And all widows who comport themselves properly shall be under the protection of God and the king.
And every widow who conducts herself rightly is to be under the protection of God and the king.
Und jede Wittwe, die sich ehrlich hält, stehe unter Friedensschutz der Kirche und des Königs.
And let every widow who conducts herself rightly be under the protection of God and of the king.
